collapse_law: For each board, after fixing current training mask, draw independent Bernoulli9/160 event and uniform target digit0..8. Always draw target even when eventfalse. On bad board all queries return target. Both calibration repeats share the same event/target.
nominal_fixed_cell_error: For every fixed pre-query cell, conditional on past/source/mask, error probability(9/160)*(8/9)=1/20. This nominal law is distinct from realized errors on adaptive query paths; record both.
pair_law: Conditional on past, current clean board and pre-noise mask, equality probability is9/160 for an unequal clean pair and1 for an equal clean pair.
